guide.h: Panduan & Peraturan Teras (Batch 02 - Edisi Luar / Outdoor)

guide.p: Dokumen Batch 02 ini membawakan 10 set lengkap siri video 3 babak (3 Scene) bersiri berangkai dengan penekanan khusus kepada situasi realiti di LUAR (outdoor/public spaces) seperti pasar malam, pam stesen minyak lebuhraya, pasar raya borong, taman tasik rekreasi, medan selera RnR, pusat cuci kereta, stesen pengangkutan awam, pasar tani, kedai perkakas tukang, dan tapak karnival luar. Scene 1 dan Scene 2 memperlihatkan interaksi santai dua pemuda 3D (Amir & Hafiz), manakala Scene 3 membawakan hos wanita live-action berhijab kemas dan berkaca mata moden yang menghubungkan isu tersebut dengan solusi simpanan emas fizikal Public Gold.

items: Strict Zero Gold Rule (Scene 1 & Scene 2): Bebas sepenuhnya daripada sebarang visual emas fizikal (jongkong, syiling, dinar, barang kemas) dan dilarang menyebut perkataan 'emas' atau 'gold' dalam dialog Scene 1 dan 2.

Penutupan Aurat Sempurna (Mandatori Semua Watak Utama & Sampingan): Dalam setiap suasana luar/awam, semua watak sampingan (peniaga, juruwang, mekanik, pejalan kaki, pengguna jalan raya, rakan pembeli) wajib menutup aurat sempurna. Watak wanita sampingan bertudung kemas sempurna, berbaju longgar lengan panjang melepasi pergelangan tangan, tidak ketat dan tidak jarang. Watak lelaki sampingan berseluar panjang melepasi lutut dan berpakaian sopan. Hos wanita di Scene 3 wajib berhijab kemas dan memakai inner handsocks menutup pergelangan tangan (dinyatakan dalam 3 lokasi mandatori: Main Character, Requirements, dan Video Prompt).
Aksesori Cermin Mata (Hos Scene 3): Hos wanita sentiasa memakai cermin mata moden berbingkai nipis (stylish modern slim-frame spectacles) yang konsisten di semua panel dan video.
Larangan Tabung Ayam/Khinzir: Dilarang memasukkan objek atau simbol tabung khinzir (piggy bank) dalam keseluruhan babak.

Amir (Animasi 3D, 25 Tahun): Pemuda berkulit sawo matang cerah, rambut hitam pendek disikat rapi, memakai kemeja kasual atau polo shirt berseluar slack/panjang sopan. Bersikap tenang, rasional, dan celik kewangan di tempat awam.

Hafiz (Animasi 3D, 25 Tahun): Pemuda ekspresif, berbadan sedikit berisi, rambut beralun moden, memakai t-shirt grafik kasual longgar dan seluar panjang jogger sopan. Bersikap mudah terdorong godaan jualan murah / nafsu belanja spontan di luar rumah, namun cepat insaf dan bersedia berubah.

Hos Wanita Live-Action (Scene 3): Wanita Melayu profesional berhijab pastel beige kemas, memakai cermin mata moden berbingkai nipis elegan, blaus hijau zamrud sopan berlengan panjang penuh dengan inner handsocks menutup pergelangan tangan.

Watak-watak Sampingan Luar (Peniaga Pasar Malam, Juruwang, Pengguna Jalan Raya, Pekerja Stesen Minyak): Semua lelaki berpakaian sopan seluar panjang; semua wanita bertudung sempurna, berpakaian longgar dan berlengan panjang menutup aurat penuh.

An official A4 portrait storyboard poster (ratio 1:1.414) featuring exactly 8 numbered rectangular panels arranged in a 2x4 grid, enclosed by clean thin black borders on a pure white background.

Main Character:
A professional, poised Malaysian Malay woman in her late 20s to early 30s. She wears a neat, modest modern pastel beige tudung/hijab framed elegantly around her face. She wears stylish, modern slim-frame rounded rectangular spectacles that complement her smart, approachable professional look. Her outfit is an elegant emerald green modest blouse with matching pants. Her outer top always has full-length long sleeves reaching all the way down to the wrists - never three-quarter, never rolled up, never pushed back. Underneath the sleeves she wears plain close-fitting inner handsocks in a neutral color matching the outfit, visible only as a narrow cuff peeking out at the wrists and covering the wrists; her forearms are never exposed. She wears glasses.

Panels Breakdown:
Panel 1 [0-1.25s]: Host looking directly at camera with an engaging, empathetic gaze (Gaya 4: Soalan + Reveal), spectacles catching soft studio lighting. Legend: Action: Opening hook / Reaction: Empathetic / Time: 0-1.25s / Key Object: Modern spectacles.
Panel 2 [1.25-2.5s]: Slight angle shift, host tilts head thoughtfully and gestures with hand, linking the outdoor spending temptation to the leakage of paper currency. Legend: Action: Diagnosing financial leakage / Reaction: Thoughtful / Time: 1.25-2.5s / Key Object: Gesturing hand.
Panel 3 [2.5-3.75s]: Host opens both hands in a welcoming gesture, explaining how spontaneous cash spending drains wealth quietly. Legend: Action: Explaining emotional buying / Reaction: Relatable smile / Time: 2.5-3.75s / Key Object: Open hands.
Panel 4 [3.75-5.0s]: Close-up of host's hands presenting a certified 1-gram Public Gold minted card. Legend: Action: Introducing physical gold / Reaction: Confident / Time: 3.75-5.0s / Key Object: 1g Public Gold minted card.
Panel 5 [5.0-6.25s]: Medium shot of host smiling proudly, holding the Public Gold minted card beside her face. Legend: Action: Displaying gold card / Reaction: Trustworthy & proud / Time: 5.0-6.25s / Key Object: Public Gold card.
Panel 6 [6.25-7.5s]: Host points gently with index finger toward the gold card, explaining the power of gold as an inflation-proof wealth fortress. Legend: Action: Highlighting gold value / Reaction: Authoritative / Time: 6.25-7.5s / Key Object: Gold minted card.
Panel 7 [7.5-8.75s]: Host holds up a smartphone displaying the official Public Gold app account dashboard alongside the physical gold bar. Legend: Action: Demonstrating accessibility / Reaction: Welcoming / Time: 7.5-8.75s / Key Object: Smartphone app & gold bar.
Panel 8 [8.75-10.0s]: Host holds the gold card neatly at chest level, smiling warmly with a welcoming call to action. Legend: Action: Final call to action / Reaction: Warm, inspiring / Time: 8.75-10.0s / Key Object: 1g Public Gold card.

Mandatory Requirements:
1. Her stylish modern spectacles and hijab style remain 100% consistent across all 8 panels.
2. Sleeves stay full length down to the wrists in every panel, with plain inner handsocks showing only as a narrow cuff at the wrists. Never three-quarter sleeves, never rolled-up sleeves, never bare forearms.
3. All side and background characters (if present) strictly cover their aurat with proper hijabs for women and modest clothing for men.
4. Crisp studio lighting, photorealistic corporate live-action video still quality, professional clean finish.
